issuer: the State Traffic Safety Inspectorate (Госавтоинспекция) of the Ministry of Internal Affairs
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the texts of the federal laws as ConsultantPlus reproduces them (the official legal portal, pravo.gov.ru, answered 503, and Gosuslugi didn't connect, so the sources are marked secondary, resting on the laws as officially published). Federal Law No. 196-FZ 'On road traffic safety': art. 26 admits drivers of category B from 18; art. 25(6) issues the national licence for ten years unless a federal law provides otherwise (licences expiring in 2022 to 2025 were extended three years, not held). The Tax Code, art. 333.33(1)(43.1), as amended by Federal Law No. 271-FZ of 31 July 2025 (the consolidated text dated 4 August 2026): the state duty for issuing a national driving licence made on a plastic base is 4,000 roubles. The internal passport is another office's and isn't held; no exchange list is held.
